subject: Request: onboarding window padding & sandbox credits
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <elena@novaforge.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir@novaforge.com>
Date: 2027-07-02T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Onboarding slip — request for window padding + sandbox credits

Hi Rafael,

Quick note from our side: our eng team hit a blocker integrating our service account with your SSO connector — it looks like the identity token exchange requires a config change on our side and our vendor needs another sprint to finish the change (they're out this week). That pushes our end-to-end onboarding by ~3 weeks.

We're still committed to the POC but need two things to keep momentum on the product side:
- A 30-day extension of our onboarding window (we were supposed to go live by July 15).
- A temporary sandbox credit top-up equivalent to ~200k tokens to keep the internal evaluation and demo flows going while we wait for the connector.

I've attached the sandbox usage export so you can see how we're consuming credits and where the burst is coming from. Our CSM (Samir) is on this thread — can we get guidance on whether Redwood can approve a one-off credit supplement and the timeline for the window extension?

Appreciate any flexibility here — engineering delay is the only blocker.

Thanks,
Elena Ruiz
Head of Integrations
Novaforge
Attachments: sandbox-usage-20270702.csv

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@novaforge.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir@novaforge.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-07-02T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding slip — request for window padding + sandbox credits

Hi Elena — thanks for the clear note and for sending the usage file. I pulled the CSV and can see the spike around your test harness runs. Two quick asks so I can move this through approvals:

1) Can you confirm the exact new target go‑live date (so we can calculate the extension)?
2) Do you have a one‑page Mutual Action Plan (MAP) update you can drop in Drive? We need to capture milestone changes to align internal ops.

Immediate next steps from my side: I'll loop Sales Ops and CS for a short feasibility check. We typically can approve a short sandbox bump (30–90k tokens) on the spot; larger supplements require manager sign‑off. If you can share an updated MAP and the high‑level impact of a 30 vs 200k supplement, it will speed things up.

I'll be out of pocket late afternoon but will follow up first thing tomorrow with options.

—Rafael

Date: 2027-07-03T09:00:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Onboarding slip — request for window padding + sandbox credits (Novaforge)

Folks — forwarding Novaforge's note. They report a 3‑week integration delay and are asking for a 30‑day onboarding extension plus ~200k token sandbox top‑up. I attached their usage file and a quick MAP link in HubSpot.

Options I see:
- Option A (conservative): approve a 14‑day extension + 75k token sandbox top‑up immediately (can be done by CS manager).
- Option B (customer success focused): approve 30‑day extension + 150k token top‑up, require updated MAP and signoff on the SSO checklist before further top‑ups.
- Option C (escalate): full 30‑day + 200k token grant — needs commercial approval and a short exec note for exceptions.

Their POC has real momentum with product and sales — approving Option B would be lowest friction and keeps us protected (MAP + checklist). If Ops approves Option B I can capture the commitments and add the MAP to the deal record.

Marissa, Ben — what do you recommend? If approved, I'll send the customer the written confirmation and the conditional terms (MAP + security signoff).

Rafael

Attachments included for internal review: MutualActionPlan_Novaforge.docx, sso-checklist.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elena Ruiz <elena@novaforge.com>, Samir Patel <samir@novaforge.com>
Date: 2027-07-03T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Onboarding slip — request for window padding + sandbox credits (Novaforge)

+1 for Option B. Approve a 30‑day onboarding extension and a 150k token sandbox supplement, contingent on:
- Updated MAP uploaded to the HubSpot deal record (link in related_links)
- SSO checklist completed and acknowledged by Novaforge engineering (we need the ticket ID or a short note)

Ben — please action the credit top‑up once Rafael confirms the MAP link. I'll log the exception in our approvals spreadsheet and update the deal in HubSpot. Rafael — capture the MAP in the record and I'll close the loop on billing and the credit ledger.

Marissa Cole
Sales Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>

Date: 2027-07-08T15:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding slip — request for window padding + sandbox credits

Hi Elena — good news: we can approve a 30‑day extension of your onboarding window and a 150k token sandbox supplement, subject to the two conditions Marissa flagged:

1) Please upload an updated Mutual Action Plan (one page is fine) to the HubSpot deal record or the Drive link I shared.
2) Confirm the SSO checklist items are captured (ticket ID or short engineering acknowledgement) — once we have that, Ben will apply the credit top‑up and I'll update the deal timeline.

If you want the credit applied sooner, share the MAP link and the SSO ticket and Ben will provision the supplement within one business day. We're keeping the ask conservative relative to the initial 200k number, but if you need a larger one we can escalate.

Thanks for flagging this early — happy to help Novaforge keep momentum on the evaluation.

Best,
